findings.title: Returned tuple is compared to an int in planner
findings.body: The new `until_service` returns a tuple `(km_left, days_left)`, but the planner compares it directly to `SERVICE_WINDOW_KM` on line 14 of `planner.py`. This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Compare against the first element of the tuple instead.

findings.title: Plate label function is vulnerable to injection
findings.body: The docstring claims the function returns a sanitized plate label, but `plate.upper().replace(" ", "")` does not prevent injection of control characters or malicious payloads. An attacker could craft a plate like `AB 123 CD; rm -rf /` and have it executed if the label is later embedded in a shell command or template. Sanitize the input with a strict allowlist of alphanumeric characters and spaces.

summary.problem: The change introduces a runtime error in the planner and a security vulnerability in the plate label function.
summary.done_well: The new `until_service` function provides both kilometer and day-based service windows, improving the planner's decision logic.
